Comments.value:
A deep cavern beneath the village of Old Stone in Deep Wood that has long served as a nest for the Blind Foot Clan. While the surface militia can easily deal with goblins, the cavern also holds ancient elven relics that remain active, allowing some elven spirits to remain behind after the city's fall.

Things to find here:
- Blind Foot Goblins (scouts, warriors, slings)
- Undead (skeletons, lesser shadows, specters)
- Elemental Fundamentals (dark, arcane, earth, water)
- Treasure Hunter (rogue, bandits)

The undead presence is fading as the goblins spread through the lower sections of the caverns, clearing out the old fonts of power. Some locked sections will prevent the goblins from ever fully causing the elves to fade here (without DM influence), however. While goblin shamans do not appear in this section of the cave, their presence of the fundamentals can be attributed to either the elven magic that persists or that of shamans who dabble in this force through the eleven relics they possess.
